vendors.name: Southern California Tribal FDPIR Food Distribution
vendors.tagline: USDA FDPIR; monthly distribution rotates to each reservation (Pala, Rincon, Pauma, La Jolla, San Pasqual, Mesa Grande, Los Coyotes, Campo, Viejas, Barona, Santa Ysabel). Call for the current calendar.
vendors.description: Free food at Southern California Tribal FDPIR Food Distribution (Southern California Tribal Chairmen's Association). Schedule: USDA FDPIR; monthly distribution rotates to each reservation (Pala, Rincon, Pauma, La Jolla, San Pasqual, Mesa Grande, Los Coyotes, Campo, Viejas, Barona, Santa Ysabel). Call for the current calendar.. Eligibility: Tribal/Native American low-income households near reservations; cannot also receive CalFresh; SSN required. Call (760) 749-5608 to confirm before you go — hours change and supplies can run out. Source: community research, Sep 2026.
